name: Redemptor Dreadnought
oracle_text:
Fallen Warrior — As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard.
Trample
Plasma Incinerator — Whenever this creature attacks, if a card is exiled with it, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the power of the exiled card.
blocked_sentences: Fallen Warrior — As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard.
Plasma Incinerator — Whenever this creature attacks, if a card is exiled with it, it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the power of the exiled card.

needs.what: an `exile_from_graveyard` paid as a spell's (optional) additional cost that links the exiled card to the permanent the spell becomes (607.2a), so the permanent's later abilities can read it with `{"zone": "exile", "exiled_with": "self"}` -- here for an attack trigger whose condition is `exists` over that selector and whose `pump` amount is `power_of` the linked card
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `additional_cost` + `additional_optional` can charge `exile_from_graveyard: {types: [Creature]}`, but `costs.pay` exiles via `zones.exile(cause="cost")` without calling `link_exiled`, so `exiled_by` is never set and `exiled_with: self` matches nothing; the cost's `as` binding lives only on the stack item, not on the resolved permanent, and `additional_paid` says only whether the cost was paid, not which card (or its power) was exiled
